text:
ashley: quick heads-up — i'm handing off the telemetry sprint artifacts to eng-platform. goal: ship token-cost attribution + latency breakdowns for the ML endpoints. milestone = canary by Fri EOD. blockers: event schema rename, and the kv-ingest PR is stuck in CI. need clear owners and short plan.

ben: i can own the latency breakdowns and dashboards. i'll wire up the profiling hooks and add the per-route latency slices. @caroline can you take token attribution?

caroline: i can, but need clarification on schema fields — analytics moved from `tokens` -> `token_count` in event.schema.v3 which breaks the mapping. where's the canonical mapping doc?

ashley: mapping draft is in the telemetry repo under docs/mapping.md but it's stale. david was working on a migration script.

david: correct — i opened PR #842 to add compatibility shim + migration. right now it's blocked by the compatibility test that validates downstream consumers. infra-bot flagged a failing smoke test yesterday.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: CI failed on `kinesis-lag-smoke` for branch telemetry/pr/842. snippet: ```ERROR: consumer read timeout after 30s
Trace: kinesis-consumer: failed to poll shard 12
Action: investigate consumer checkpointing and retry policy```

emily: i'll take the PR for a local run and see if i can reproduce the kinesis timeout. suggestion: for the canary we can add a mapping fallback in the pipeline like `tokens = token_count || estimate_tokens(text)` so consumers won't break.

ben: agree with fallback. i'll also add a canary routing rule (5% traffic) and an alert if token-cost delta > 10% vs baseline.

caroline: adding myself to the README owners list now. also i'll add a small smoke-check script that asserts both `tokens` and `token_count` variants are handled.

david: pinged @frank to review #842 and the migration script — we need a second pair of eyes on the checkpointing change. frank — any chance you can review today?

frank: got the ping, will review in ~2 hours. if the change is small i'll approve and we can merge with a fast-track.

ashley: thanks all. rough plan recap: 1) frank reviews + merge #842 (target: today), 2) emily runs local smoke + fixes kinesis retry config if needed, 3) caroline adds fallback mapping + smoke script, 4) ben wires dashboards + canary routing (5%) + cost-alerts. canary Fri morning if merge happens today; full rollout Sun morning.

ben: ETA for dashboard + routing: EOD Thursday. i'll post the canary config in this thread when it's ready.

caroline: owner noted in README and opened a small PR with smoke script (telemetry/ci/PR-129).

emily: reproduced the timeout locally — increasing consumer read timeout to 60s stabilizes the smoke tests. i pushed a config change to #842.

frank: reviewed #842, left one minor comment about checkpoint backoff. after that looks good — will approve.

david: awesome — merging after frank's approval. i'll also tag infra to watch the canary.

ashley: :thumbsup: action items captured. if anything slips, please ping this thread. i'll update the sprint board with owners and dates.

ben: posted canary config: `route: telemetry-attrib-v2, percent: 5, fallback: attrib-v1`. link: https://git.internal/redwood/telemetry/canaries/5pc.json

caroline: smoke PR merged. added test cases for both field names.

frank: approved #842, merged at 3359880000.

david: merged migration and config. canary scheduled Fri 09:00 PT.

ashley: closing loop — canary check at Fri 10:00 PT standup. thanks team.
